title: Still Early — Perth startup research list
geography: Greater Perth, including Fremantle and metropolitan suburbs; additional WA-linked leads are separated.
completeness: Non-exhaustive research list, not a verified census of active Perth startups.
import_guidance: Do not publish every row as a confirmed Perth startup. Retain group and perth_relationship fields.
Confirm operating status, company identity, official domain, logo and location before publication.
No street coordinates were collected. Do not pin every company at the Perth CBD centroid or invent addresses.
Website links are included only when identified in consulted sources. Null means not independently identified here.
Investor portfolios, awards and programme membership establish association, not headquarters.
Research date is the date consulted; it is not a claim that each source was updated that day.
No user website or database was modified.

group_definitions.perth_evidence: Perth location reported in company, partner, registry, or other named source. This does not always prove headquarters or current trading status.
group_definitions.perth_directory_listing: Listed in a Perth directory. Location and trading status need independent confirmation.
group_definitions.wa_portfolio_lead: Named in a WA investor portfolio. Investment by a WA fund does not establish a Perth location.
group_definitions.plus_eight_alumni: Earlier Plus Eight alumni. Current business identity, trading status and Perth location need checking.
group_definitions.venture_uwa_2025_2026: Venture UWA incubator listing. Includes early concepts. Confirm entity and Perth location.
group_definitions.curtin_accelerate_2026: Curtin Accelerate cohort. WA programme participation does not establish a Perth office.
group_definitions.plus_eight_2026: 2026 Plus Eight cohort. Confirm current entity, domain and Perth office.
group_definitions.perth_pre_accelerator_2026: City of Perth pre-accelerator cohort. Includes concepts, services and brands rather than only incorporated technology startups.
group_definitions.wa_awards_2026: WA innovation award finalist. Confirm Greater Perth location; WA is not synonymous with Perth.
group_definitions.biodesign_lead: Perth Biodesign association. Confirm current location and business identity.
group_definitions.established_or_listed_tech: Established, acquired or listed technology business to keep separate from early-stage startups.
